connector.name: MCP by aicandidatehub.com
connector.registryDescription: Profile, CV, jobs, compensation & application-tracking tools for AI agents, by aicandidatehub.com.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.aicandidatehub, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CANDIDATEHUB_TOKEN
env.description: Personal Access Token minted at https://www.aicandidatehub.com/account/mcp-tokens (format chmcp_…). Required by all API-backed tools; the server starts and lists tools without it.
